title: Macropad, module on top: MX keys and a 2.0 in display
note: The front-mount macropad built: twelve MX switches soldered to the board (no plate) with DSA keycaps, a DO-35 diode in the gap beside each, the thin module soldered flat on its castellated pads above the keys, and a 2.0 in ST7789 display in the SPI socket at the module's right end, lying over the module. The board's underside is z = 0.
